# Review of the identification

## Summary

The draft evaluates a policy adopted by 12 of 24 units of a synthetic panel with a staggered difference-in-differences design. The design fits staggered adoption: group-time effects against the year before adoption, never-adopters as controls, effects by event time with a joint pre-trends test, a placebo and a sensitivity bound.

## Points to address

1. Say why no covariates are needed for parallel trends here.
2. Report the relative-magnitudes bound for more than one Mbar.
